result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, and Adobe Acrobat Sign** are the three strongest e-signature options.

My recommendation would be **Dropbox Sign for simplicity and value**, or **DocuSign if you regularly send contracts to clients, suppliers, or employees and need more advanced workflows**\.

The best choice depends on how many documents you send each month, whether you need multiple people to sign, and how important integrations and compliance features are.

## Best e-signature software compared

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable templates and signing reminders.
- Audit trails and document tracking.
- Good Dropbox and Google Drive integration.
- Paid plans with unlimited signature requests according to current plan comparisons.

Best for: consultants, agencies, freelancers and small businesses sending routine contracts.

Pricing varies by plan; check current Australian pricing.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall business solution)

- Widely recognised by customers and organisations.
- Strong document tracking and audit trails.
- Templates and automated signing workflows.
- Extensive integrations.
- More advanced identity verification options.

Best for: businesses sending contracts regularly or managing multiple signatories.

[DocuSign Australia](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF workflows)

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Works well with Adobe Acrobat.
- Document tracking and audit trails.
- Microsoft 365 integrations.

Best for: businesses that already use Adobe Acrobat for document management.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business/sign.html)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Document templates.
- Electronic signatures.
- Sales document tracking and payment features.

Best for: businesses that send proposals, quotes and contracts together.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Sign**

(Best budget-friendly option)

- Good document automation.
- Reusable templates.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho applications.
- Suitable for smaller teams.

Best for: businesses looking to keep software costs down.

[Zoho Sign website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

These recommendations reflect current product comparisons and feature positioning. ## What I'd look for before choosing

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

| Feature | Why it matters |
|--------|--------|
| Reusable templates | Avoid recreating contracts |
| Audit trail | Evidence of who signed and when |
| Automatic reminders | Reduce chasing clients |
| Multiple signatories | Allow several people to sign |
| Mobile signing | Clients can sign from their phones |
| Integrations | Connect with accounting and CRM software |
| Reasonable sending limits | Avoid unexpected costs |


**One Australian consideration\:** Electronic signatures are recognised for many transactions under the Electronic Transactions Act 1999 and relevant state legislation, although some document types have additional requirements. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to Dropbox Sign and DocuSign first.

But I can make a much more precise recommendation with one detail\:

**What type of small business do you run?**

For example, consulting, construction, professional services, real estate, trades, retail or something else?

That will help me identify the best platform, including whether an Australian option such as Annature or FuseSign might be a better fit.

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
